title: Direct Go ResourceSearchRequest clients must set FIELD_VALUES
answers: Why does my PR fail the 'Require FIELD_VALUES for new direct Go search clients' check?
How do I construct a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest in Go without failing CI?
What result format should a new Go ResourceSearchRequest use?
pr-resource-search-result-format.yml workflow failing, what to do
body: Invariant: any newly-added Go construction of resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest (composite literal, new(), var zero-value, including grouped var blocks) must set ResultFormat to resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES. This is enforced in CI by a semgrep scan that diffs against the PR base commit, so only *new* occurrences are flagged — pre-existing code using other formats is untouched. If a different format is genuinely required for compatibility, suppress the finding at the allocation site with a `// nosemgrep` style reason comment rather than removing the check. Enforced in .github/workflows/pr-resource-search-result-format.yml using pkg/storage/unified/semgrep/resource-search-field-values.yaml; skipping it lets new clients regress to the old result format, breaking mixed-version decode compatibility.
applies: Any Go code in this repo (outside resourcepb, testing helpers, and the semgrep fixture itself) that constructs a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest.
